The guard at Fem.f90:12768 refuses any CONTACT material with igap0/=99, for every constitutive model, because the consumer at :12936 is not GOODMAN-specific. NO numerical behaviour is changed on any path that was already reachable: no golden case declares a CONTACT material, and all nine reproduce their frozen references bit-for-bit after the change.
